scope: Scoped portable implementation/build/test/static/consumer/archive verification only. Not production release or native qualification.

counts.note: Release/repetitions/archive reruns and parameterized cases do not increase unique-test totals.

selectedAgentKernel.limit: Exact-source qualification manifest excluding Manager; not full Agent host.

optimized.scope: Account(50), Text(3), Image(3) tests; TextProvider build.

actualLocalHTTP.scope: 44 tests, three passes. Real local URLSession sockets, not remote ChatGPT.

publicConsumer.scope: Public README APIs compile/link, Core and explicit unsupported-host behavior run; no login/model/image live calls.

static.limit: Parsing is not Apple SDK typecheck.

documents.limit: Relative link/shape validation, not external URL availability or semantic proof.

archiveExtraction.limit: Full candidate ZIP extracted and actual Account manifest tested. Final ZIP appends evidence; qualified source identity separately verified when sealed.

criticalReview.kind: Same-worker critical self-review from ownership, failure/framing, minimality/public-contract perspectives; no independent external reviewer.

regressionsAndHarnessEvents.note: Raw RED/failing evidence preserved. Document checker first reported its own not-yet-created report; second run checked the generated report and all links. Raw HTTP CRLF test payloads excluded from authored whitespace lint.

notRun.name: CallbackNativeTests / Keychain / PKCE
notRun.reason: Apple SDK unavailable. Direct Network/CryptoKit import probes failed; conditional code excluded by Linux builds.

notRun.name: Full ChatGPT composition / artifact / Apple providers
notRun.reason: Required Apple SDK unavailable. Full failing builds not repeated after SDK probes.

notRun.name: ASKAgentTools / MCP / MigrationHold native parity
notRun.reason: Unchanged optional dependency/native scope. Prior resolution/tools-version failures retained only as imported evidence; not relabeled as new runs.

notRun.name: Actual ChatGPT account / images / host UI / vendor inference
notRun.reason: No credentials, approved remote quota/effects, Apple host/device or model artifacts.

delivery: Full source SwiftPM package collection, not a signed app or native binary. Final SOURCE_MANIFEST excludes itself; external ZIP SHA-256 seals all bytes.
